title: docs(adr): ADR-0048 status line — a bare doc read of a two-holder name refuses 409, outside the no-dependency carve-out
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9C7rWNzJMFeK8c5txXCZvNU)_

Fixes #34069

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只动一处文字。ADR-0048 的状态行末尾追加一条 2026-11-15 的修订记录:对文档(doc)类型,「没有依赖关系的包仍按 §3.3」这句保留不再适用。两个或更多启用的包有同名文档时,不指明包的按名读取返回 409 并列出每个包。原有文字一个字符没动,没有代码改动。
- 为什么改:裁决 6893582352(选项 A「A 拒绝并列出候选」)已定,代码已由 PR #34036 合入主干,而 ADR-0048 的状态行还写着旧行为,照 ADR 干活的人和 AI 会按旧句子理解。裁决点名这条状态行由 skills 线的卡承接。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不发布、不改任何运行时行为;风险只在措辞是否与裁决一致。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` 第 3 行(状态行)行尾新增的那一条 `· **Amended** (2026-11-15, …)`,这是唯一的改动。重点看三句:只收窄 §3.3 的不指明包读取;§3.4 与 ADR-0146 D8 不动;doc 仍在 ADR-0150 D1 第 1 桶(不是换桶)。
- 两分钟验证:本地跑 `git diff --word-diff origin/main...HEAD -- docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`,预期只看到一段 `{+ … +}` 新增、没有任何 `[- … -]` 删除。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(Tier H:状态行改动不走低风险放权,只能由维护者批准后落地)。

## What changes

One file, one line, add-only: `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` line 3 (`**Status**:`) gains one dated entry at its end, in the form the line's existing amendments take. The appended text, whole:

```text
 · **Amended** (2026-11-15, [#34069](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/34069)): the sentence above that "Packages with no dependency relation keep §3.3 and §3.4 as written" no longer covers `doc` for §3.3's context-free read — a by-name read of a `doc` that names no package (`GET /meta/doc/NAME` and the in-process `MetadataFacade.get` alike), of a name two or more enabled packages hold, answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder, so §3.3's "it returns the first match" no longer describes that read (ruling record [`6893582352`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33264#issuecomment-6893582352) on #33264, option A; shipped by PR [#34036](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/34036): `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts#resolveItem`, which the protocol's by-name read asks before any layer through `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts#refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead`; pinned in `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`). Unchanged: a name one package holds, a read that names its package (`?package=`, a package caller) and the environment's own item, which still answers first where the registry holds it; a disabled package holds no name. Not a re-bucketing: `doc` keeps its literal global name and its addressing (ADR-0150 D1 bucket 1), and this entry moves nothing else — §3.4's half of that sentence and ADR-0146 D8 read as before.
```

How the entry is scoped, and why:

- **Only the §3.3 half of the carve-out sentence.** The ruling's words are "packages with no dependency keep the old sentence": the old sentence is §3.3's context-free read ("it returns the first match"). PR #34036 changes a read and no registration path, so the entry says the §3.4 half of that sentence reads as before rather than taking `doc` out of both.
- **Not a re-bucketing.** `doc` stays in ADR-0150 D1 bucket 1 (global literal name, addressing unchanged), as the ruling and the card's prior-rulings note say. ADR-0146 and ADR-0150 are not edited.
- **Anchors.** The entry carries two `path#symbol` anchors and one file-level anchor (the pin), all on the status line itself, so `check:adr-symbol-anchors` reds if the refusal's door is renamed or removed.
- **Nothing else moves.** No other line of the record changes; `docs/adr/README.md` is untouched because the index regenerates identical (below).

## Tests

Docs-only: no test is added or edited (no forced test edit), and nothing is ablated because no tested behaviour changes. What was measured instead, at head `f4d28180`:

- **Add-only, byte level.** The base file is the head file with 1445 bytes inserted at one offset and 0 bytes removed; line 3 is the only differing line and the base line 3 is a prefix of the head line 3. `git diff --word-diff` shows one added span and no removed span.
- **The anchors are read.** `check:adr-symbol-anchors` on the base tree resolves 3622 anchors (1050 symbol, 2520 file-level); on the head 3625 (1052 symbol, 2521 file-level): the entry's two symbol anchors and one file-level anchor, each resolving.
- **The index does not move.** `scripts/adr-index.mjs` reads the status keyword as the vocabulary entry appearing EARLIEST within the first 80 characters of the value; the value starts `Revised`, and the first `Amended` in the head value sits at character 1272 (an entry that was already there). The generator's own `parseRecord` gives the same keyword, date and superseded-by for ADR-0048 at base and head, and `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` exits 0 with `docs/adr/README.md is current`.

## Acceptance notes

**Premise, re-read at `origin/main` `385ea1cc`.** PR #34036 is on main as `5af956f3` ("fix(objectql)!: a bare doc read refuses a name two enabled packages hold, naming both"). What it ships, from source:

- The code and status: `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, class `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`: `readonly code = 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT';` and `readonly status = 409;`.
- The seam: `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` hands a `doc` read with no caller package to its bare-doc read, which throws that error with `reason: 'ambiguous-in-environment'` and one candidate per enabled package holder when two or more hold the name.
- The protocol door: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, in the by-name read: `if (!request.packageId && request.type === 'doc') refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead(host, request.name, member);`, before any layer is read.
- The covered reads, in the PR's changeset (`.changeset/33264-bare-doc-read-refusal.md`): "a by-name read of a doc that names no package (`GET /meta/doc/NAME` and the doors that read through it, `MetadataFacade.get`/`getEntry`), of a name two or more enabled packages hold, moves from one holder's body, picked by registration order, to `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder. Unchanged: one holder, a read that names the package, the environment's own item."
- The pins: `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`, the describe titled "[ruling 6893582352] doc (ADR-0150 D1 bucket 1): a bare read of a name two enabled packages hold is refused" (both registration orders; controls for one holder, the exact address and a package caller, a disabled holder, the environment's own item).

**The ruling.** Record [6893582352](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33264#issuecomment-6893582352) on #33264 (maintainer, 2026-11-15T11:23Z). Chosen option, verbatim as the decision card read: 「A 拒绝并列出候选」. The line this card carries out, verbatim:

> The ADR-0048 status line drops its "packages with no dependency keep the old sentence" carve-out for `doc`. That is a docs/adr/** status-line edit, carried by a domain:skills card.

**Landing tier: H.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` answers GOVERNED, landing tier H, for `docs/adr/**`. The low-risk add-only arm does not take this diff: appending to an existing line is one line removed and one added to git, and the arm's reader (`addOnlyNoteReasons`, run on this branch's full-context diff) answers "removes 1 line(s) — an add-only note changes no existing line"; by its own rules it also refuses a status line and any line in a record's header block. A status-line edit is what the ruling orders, so this PR stays a draft and waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.

**Model tier (deviation, declared).** `dispatch-gates --tier` reads MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for `docs/adr/**`, with no one-line exit. The card thread is served below that tier, so the text was authored in an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER on this same branch, as the claim's `Container & model` line records.

**Noted, not filed.**

- The entry says the environment's own item answers first "where the registry holds it". That is the reading PR #34036 implements and pins (a package-less row only the store holds is no exemption); the ruling's own sentence is the shorter "the environment's own saved row still answers first". The gap was declared in that PR's report and is its seat's to confirm; this entry records what the code does and claims no more.
- §3.3's body carries no in-place pointer to the status line's entries about it (neither ADR-0146's nor this one). The card's surface is the status line alone and "no other sentence moves", so none is added here.
